decisions.title: Evergreen Dependency Model
decisions.rule: Target current stable runtimes (Node 24+, Python 3.12+). Deprecated packages and deprecation warnings are fatal build errors (Zero Warnings).

decisions.title: Domain Isolation (WHAT ⟂ HOW)
decisions.rule: Never mix environments/ (WHAT) and design_system/ (HOW) in one Change Set. Never hand-edit build/staging/**.

decisions.title: Evidence Gate / Zero Hallucination
decisions.rule: No invented tokens, CSS classes, DOM nodes, entities, or plugins. Missing Source of Truth → FATAL_EXCEPTION / HALT.

decisions.title: GitOps Agent Boundary
decisions.rule: Agent boundary ends at Git. Forbidden: publish_edge.sh, SSH writes, ad-hoc Edge copies, local deploy scripts. CI alone publishes to Edge on main.

decisions.title: MCP Control Plane Execution Harness
decisions.rule: Agents MUST prefer m2m-ha-glass-harness typed Tools, Resources, and Prompts. Load STD via index + path-scoped domain files or m2m://graph/std/{domain} — never the full STD corpus in one turn. Working memory SoT is FSM _local_ai/memory/stm/state.json (m2m://graph/state/{task_id}). Inter-agent exchange uses m2m/v1 A2A payloads.

decisions.title: Observability, Golden Evals & Risk Gates
decisions.rule: Golden Intent evals gate harness regressions. MCP tools are risk-classified (READ_ONLY / LOCAL_MUTATION / CRITICAL_DEPLOY). LOCAL_MUTATION requires gates_passed=true. Edge CD runs a 60s REST canary with auto-rollback. Prefer fastpath_analyze before LLM review and tdd_gate_check Red/Green hooks for pipeline Python mutations (ADR-0067).

decisions.title: Tier-3 Visual LLM-as-a-Judge Eval Harness
decisions.rule: Visual & semantic LLM-as-a-Judge (DeepEval or equivalent) remains unauthorized until explicitly activated. Tier 1 schema/policy and Tier 2 Playwright sandbox remain binding.

decisions.title: VCS & Execution Governance
decisions.rule: Sync with main before new work; mutate only on <class>/<kebab-description> task branches; never develop on main. Fail-fast on first environment restriction.

decisions.title: Experience Memory Bank
decisions.rule: Experience SoT is bounded LTM _local_ai/memory/ltm/experience/ (index.json + domains/*). Before shell/env work call intercept_lesson / m2m://graph/lessons?intent= — never dual-read .agent/lessons.md. After tasks call reflect (analyze_trace_failures / reflect_on_traces) for ENVIRONMENT failures; append verified nodes only to domains/local.json (or promote to seed domains during review). Promote multi-cycle lessons during scheduled review.

decisions.title: Thin Instructions; Bounded STD SoT
decisions.rule: IDE .mdc / .cursorrules hold role, gates, and STD indices — never full constraint prose. Machine SoT lives under _local_ai/memory/ltm/ as bounded trees: std/ (rules) and experience/ (lessons). docs/adr/ is a legacy narrative archive. Monolithic std_decisions.json and playbook/lessons.json are forbidden.

decisions.title: Dual-Scope Rule Isolation (Legacy Preserved / NextGen Unconstrained)
decisions.rule: Legacy STDs stay fully enforced for the legacy dashboard scope (svitlo + shared design_system primitives/tokens). For the /m2m-nextgen scope, legacy LAYOUT restrictions are lifted: the STD-05 WHAT/HOW mixing violation is waived iff every design_system path in the Change Set is nextgen-scoped (basename starts with m2m_, or the allowlisted home_view_m2m.yaml). One legacy design_system path in the mix re-arms the violation. m2m_* templates may reuse shared theme tokens read-only but must never modify shared primitives (ADR-0014 stands).
